opportunities.requirements: No follower minimum stated. You submit work or apply per listing. Content bounties are contests, only winning entries get paid, so pick briefs in your Privacy and AI niche where your edge is real.
opportunities.reward_text: Per listing, paid in crypto (usually USDC). Platform rate card quotes $500 to $1,500 for an X thread, $500 to $1,000 for a deep dive essay
opportunities.source: Superteam Earn / Solana Compass (checked Nov 2026: 243,000+ members, Nigeria chapter exists)
opportunities.summary: The Solana ecosystem work marketplace: bounties, freelance projects and grants for writers, designers and devs. Sponsors pay the full reward, platform takes no cut. For a creator page this is the most direct money board in Web3, threads and deep dives are literally your format.
opportunities.title: Superteam Earn, content bounties and gigs marketplace

opportunities.requirements: Join project communities on Zealy and complete their Creator Quests. No wallet needed to sign up, Discord, email or X login works.
opportunities.reward_text: Per quest, paid by communities in USDC managed by Zealy, or tokens, XP and roles. Amounts vary by project and sprint
opportunities.summary: Quest platform where communities post Creator Quests that pay contributors in USDC for creating content on X, plus clipping campaigns and leaderboard sprints. A steady drip of small paid content tasks rather than one big gig, good for filling quiet days.
opportunities.title: Zealy Creator Quests, get paid USDC for X content

opportunities.requirements: Open application on the Sentient Foundation site. Selection is monthly, based on the quality, consistency and impact of your contributions. Thought leadership content about open source AI is the core of it.
opportunities.reward_text: No fixed payment stated. Each month 10 Sparks are featured: X affiliate badge, direct line to the core team, incentives and access to future contributor and leadership programs
opportunities.summary: Sentient replaced its old ambassador framing with Sentient Sparks, a contributor pathway run by the Sentient Foundation. Applications are always open and Sparks rotate monthly based on contribution quality. It rewards visibility and access rather than a salary, so treat it as reputation building inside a project you already cover on the alpha board.
opportunities.title: Sentient Sparks, contributor program for open source AI

opportunities.requirements: Positions are referral only at this time: join the PIVX Discord, apply through the official form and state who referred you. You start as an Advocate; promotion to Ambassador takes 3 months and 3 nominations from existing Ambassadors.
opportunities.reward_text: Advocates are unpaid while they build a record. Promoted Ambassadors are paid a flat monthly fee in PIV, plus Ambassador of the Month PIV polls
opportunities.summary: PIVX is a privacy cryptocurrency, one of the few ambassador programs aimed at the privacy niche itself rather than general Web3. Low competition compared to the big L1 programs, and it deepens your privacy brand while it pays.
opportunities.title: PIVX Ambassador Program, privacy coin community

opportunities.requirements: Concrete gates: Discord Level 7, at least 3 on-chain transactions on Injective, and a submitted contribution portfolio. Applications through the official Injective Discord.
opportunities.reward_text: Monthly INJ token rewards starting at the Knight rank, five ranks from Ninja to Master
opportunities.summary: Injective relaunched its ambassador program on its official site: ranks from Warrior up, Ninja Missions with 5,000 INJ up for grabs monthly, and monthly INJ rewards for top contributors as you rank up. One of the few programs whose full mechanics are public on the project's own page.
opportunities.title: Injective Ninja Masters, rank based monthly INJ rewards
Binance Square Write to Earn, weekly USDC for content engagement and reader trades
opportunities.summary: Binance Square upgraded its Write to Earn program on Oct 19, 2026: KYC-verified creators are automatically eligible after their first post, with no registration or opt-in. You earn a 20% basic commission when readers trade through your content, plus a share of a weekly Engagement Bonus pool for genuine likes, comments and follows. Rewards are calculated weekly and paid in USDC to your Spot Account by the following Thursday. There is no fixed amount per post, the engagement bonus depends on quality and volume of engagement at Binance's discretion, and fake engagement can disqualify you.
opportunities.reward_text: 20% basic commission on reader trades plus a share of a weekly Engagement Bonus pool, paid in USDC weekly. No fixed amount per post
opportunities.requirements: KYC-verified Binance account. Publish text posts, articles or videos on Binance Square. No registration needed, eligibility starts after your first post.

opportunities.title: Swap.io x402 video bounty, $200 for a 60 second pitch on agent payments
opportunities.summary: Swap.io, a Solana swap platform whose Agent API lets AI agents get swap quotes and pay per call in USDC through x402, is paying for a 60 to 120 second video pitching one concrete way an agent could use x402 with Swap.io. Post the video on X tagging @swapdotio and @Superteam, plus a Medium copy. No code needed, mockups and storyboards are welcome, and a working demo with a Solscan link earns up to 30 percent bonus. Judging weights idea and clarity at 45 percent, production quality 35 percent and X reach 20 percent. Contest, only placed entries are paid. No deadline is stated on the listing, and submissions were still open when checked on Nov 11.
opportunities.reward_text: 1st $200, 2nd $125, 3rd $80, 4th $60, 5th $35; 6th to 10th get 40k XP for Season Zero. Contest, only placed entries are paid
opportunities.requirements: One 60 to 120 second original video, one entry per participant. Post on X tagging @swapdotio and @Superteam, and on Medium linking swap.io. AI voiceovers allowed, on-camera presence preferred. Optional bonus: show a real paid call to the Swap.io Agent API with the Solscan link.
